observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge enacts authority-ranking — the speaker issues a binding order to a subordinate recipient.
Second imperative command to purge information continues the authority-ranking enactment — directive issued as an order, not a request.

mints.name: DirectiveErasureCommand
mints.title: command to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker issuing a binding order to eliminate or suppress what is known, rather than requesting or discussing it?
